name: agent_turn
description: One agent turn: build the prompt, make one LLM call (with provider web search when asked), and clean up the reply. It runs as its own workflow so that a DO_WHILE never feeds an LLM task its earlier replies.

inputParameters.queryExpression:
(.user + (if .context == null then "" else "\n\nCONTEXT (JSON):\n" + (.context | tojson) end)) as $text
| {text: $text,
   mistralBody: {model: .model, store: false, instructions: .system, inputs: $text,
                 tools: (if .webSearch == true then [{type: "web_search"}] else [] end),
                 completion_args: ({max_tokens: .maxTokens} + (if .reasoningEffort then {reasoning_effort: .reasoningEffort} else {} end))}}

def arr: if type == "array" then . else [] end;
(.body.outputs // [] | arr) as $o
| [ $o[] | select(.type == "message.output") | .content ] as $contents
| {text: ([ $contents[] | if type == "string" then . else ([ arr[] | select(.type == "text") | .text // "" ] | join("")) end ] | join("")),
   refs: ([ $contents[] | arr[] | select(.type == "tool_reference") | .url | select(type == "string") ] | unique),
   searches: ([ $o[] | select(.type == "tool.execution") ] | length),
   finishReason: (if ($contents | length) > 0 then "STOP" else "ERROR" end),
   usage: {promptTokens: .body.usage.prompt_tokens, completionTokens: .body.usage.completion_tokens,
           totalTokens: .body.usage.total_tokens, searchTokens: .body.usage.connector_tokens}}

def clean: gsub("[\r\n\t]+"; " ") | sub("^[^{]*"; "") | sub("[^}]*$"; "");
((.mistral | type) == "object") as $viaMistral
| (if $viaMistral then .mistral.text else .r end) as $r
| (if $viaMistral then .mistral.finishReason else .finishReason end) as $finish
| (if $viaMistral then .mistral.usage + {searches: .mistral.searches} else .usage end) as $usage
| (if ($r | type) == "object" then $r
   elif ($r | type) == "string" then (try ($r | clean | fromjson) catch null)
   else null end) as $obj
| (if ($r | type) == "string" then $r elif $r == null then "" else ($r | tojson) end) as $txt
| (($finish // "") | ascii_upcase) as $fr
| {ok: (if .expectJson == true then (($obj | type) == "object") else (($txt | length) > 0) end),
   data: (if .expectJson == true and ($obj | type) == "object" then $obj else null end),
   text: (if .expectJson == true then $txt[0:3000] else $txt end),
   truncated: ($fr == "LENGTH" or $fr == "MAX_TOKENS"),
   finishReason: $fr,
   usage: $usage}
